description: Standard cutwater label set. Names stay emoji-free by default; the emoji is prepended only when the interview opts in to emoji labels.

labels.name: type: fix
labels.description: Something is broken and needs fixing

labels.name: type: style
labels.description: Formatting or code style, no behavior change

labels.name: type: refactor
labels.description: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature

labels.name: type: chore
labels.description: Maintenance that does not touch source or tests

labels.name: status: blocked
labels.description: Waiting on something outside this issue

labels.name: status: needs-review
labels.description: Pull request open and waiting for review

labels.name: scope-change
labels.description: Scope changed mid-task; see the logged comment
